name: The Lady or the Tiger
source:
Alison fears rejection. One choice tonight could save her – or destroy her. She can’t know which.

Which door will you open?

[From [url=https://eddeha.itch.io/the-lady-or-the-tiger]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾莉森害怕被拒绝。今晚有一个选择可以拯救她——或者毁灭她。她不知道是哪一个。

你会打开哪扇门？

[来自[url=https://eddeha.itch.io/the-lady-or-the-tiger]Itch.io[/url]]
